lines.text: Believers are urged to be united in spirit and to consider others more important than themselves.
Christ Jesus emptied Himself, took the form of a servant, and humbled Himself to death on a mountain.
God gave Him the name above all names, so every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord.
Paul tells them to work out their salvation, since God works in them, and to do everything without fear.
The writer rejoices with them even if poured out like a drink offering, and wants them to rejoice.
